steps.content: You dive through a hail of gunfire, bullets snapping past your ears, and you feel the searing heat of a few rounds grazing your body. You stagger behind a nearby chair, heart hammering against your ribs. Then, an unfamiliar guttural rasp cuts through the chaos from right beside you.
**** off! Get out of my way!
Bang. The world goes black. You never even see the shooter.
